title: Butternut Squash Fruit Myth

scenes.text: Butternut squash weighs about two pounds
Many label it as a vegetable on grocery shelves
scenes.label: Squash is a veg

scenes.text: Botanically it’s a fruit because it develops from the flower’s ovary
scenes.label: Botanical fruit

scenes.text: Treat it like fruit in meals for more variety
scenes.label: Eat it fruit style

scenes.text: Follow if your body is worth 60 seconds a day.

description: The butternut squash is often called a veggie, yet botanically it’s a fruit. Use this tip to diversify your plate. Follow for daily food myths busted.
